Recorded responses for the Gemini picture adapter (SPEC 6.2, Phase 2 slice E).

Built by hand from the response shapes in Google's public Gemini API documentation and
the `@google/genai` types. No real call was made to get them. Every value is made up; the
picture is a 1x1 PNG.

`image-success-jpeg.json` (SPEC 6.2 [1.18]) holds a 1x1 grey baseline JPEG of 159 bytes, written
byte by byte (one quantisation table, one-code Huffman tables, one block). No real call.
